---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(f"The Bond films in this dataset run from {int(bond['year'].min())} to {int(bond['year'].max())}.")
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```
